title: Range Slider
content: Create range slider input component. Structure: track bar with draggable thumb(s). Track: bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2. Filled track: bg-blue-600 from start to current value. Thumb: w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-white border-2 border-blue-600. Dual range: two thumbs for min/max selection. Value display: current value above thumb. Keyboard: arrow keys to adjust. Accessibility: ARIA attributes.

variants.simple: Create slider input for selecting a value or range within min/max bounds.
variants.detailed: Create range slider input component. Structure: track bar with draggable thumb(s). Track: bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2. Filled track: bg-blue-600 from start to current value. Thumb: w-4 h-4 rounded-full bg-white border-2 border-blue-600. Dual range: two thumbs for min/max selection. Value display: current value above thumb. Keyboard: arrow keys to adjust. Accessibility: ARIA attributes.
variants.advanced: Create range slider input component with single or dual thumb support. Structure: relative container with track bar and draggable thumb(s). Track: bg-gray-200 rounded-full h-2 w-full. Filled track: absolute bg-blue-600 rounded-full h-2, positioned from left edge (or between thumbs for dual range) to current value percentage. Thumb: w-5 h-5 rounded-full bg-white border-2 border-blue-600 shadow-md, cursor-pointer, absolute positioned at value percentage minus half thumb width. Hover: thumb scale-110. Active/dragging: thumb ring-2 ring-blue-200. Dual range mode: two thumbs for min/max range selection, don't allow crossing (min thumb can't exceed max), filled track spans between the two thumbs. Value display: tooltip above thumb on hover/drag showing current value, or always visible in input fields on sides. Min/max labels: show minimum and maximum values at track ends. Step: configurable step increments (step={5}), snap to nearest step. Input sync: optional number input fields on each side that sync bidirectionally with slider. Mouse handling: track mouse position on track click or thumb drag, calculate percentage, apply step snapping. Keyboard: arrow keys ±1 step, Shift+arrow ±10 steps (or larger step), when thumb focused. Touch: proper touch event handling (touchstart, touchmove, touchend) for mobile, prevent scroll during drag. Tooltip: show value on hover/drag near thumb using absolute positioned div. Marks: optional tick marks at intervals with labels below track. Disabled state: grayed out track and thumb (bg-gray-100, border-gray-300), cursor-not-allowed, non-interactive. Accessibility: role="slider", aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax, aria-label, keyboard navigation. Performance: use RAF for smooth drag updates.
